question: The interface vocabulary has no term for RDP, a browser terminal or a console-only product; By-Hoster, VDSina, WindowsVPS.Host and Killercoda use RDP or a browser console as the main path. Which term should carry it?
why: interface values rest/cli on compute/windowsvps-host-windows and compute/killercoda-free are unsupported by any page read, and 'unknown' loses the RDP or console path
